<NAME>
probe_forgive</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially, then make a single probe against opponents that have never defected. If they retaliate once, forgive to restore cooperation; if they defect repeatedly, switch to defection. This preserves mutual cooperation with reciprocal opponents while exploiting unconditional cooperators.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else (1 if opponent_history.count(1) == 0 and len(opponent_history) % 20 == 0 else (1 if len(opponent_history) > 1 and opponent_history[-1] == 1 and opponent_history[-2] == 1 else 0))
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
